reason: I run one or two chairs and cut hair myself, so I don't need selfie attendance or drawer checks to know what's going on. ₹5,000 upfront plus ₹999 every month, about ₹17,000 in the first year, is too much when UPI and my notebook already do the job for free.
objection: It's a monthly subscription I'll be paying forever for a shop this small, and the free billing apps already send bills on WhatsApp. Why switch and pay more?
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and around ₹299 a month or one-time payment, with the WhatsApp reminders proven to bring customers back.
